# Photo attachments and editable AI summaries

Attach normalized private photos with explicit Gemini consent or without AI. Save a photo-only reflection, correct a summary, search the corrected text, handle failed and late AI output, enforce four attachments, remove an image, replay source events and export actual photo files. Each action compares an unmasked full-page screenshot at zero pixel tolerance. Provider replies are fictional; no live inference or journal data is used.

Viewport: desktop-chromium.
